title: Leader election, split brain and fencing

kcs.statement: Leader election picks exactly one node to perform a role, such as accepting writes or running a scheduler, and picks a new one when heartbeats show the leader is gone.
Split brain happens when a network partition lets two nodes both believe they are leader; requiring votes from a majority prevents it because only one side of a partition can hold a majority.
A leader holds a time-limited lease, and a fencing token (a number that increases with each new leader) lets storage reject writes from a stale former leader whose lease has expired.
